ns2:course.label: Social Science Research in Library and Information Science
ns2:course.description: Introduces students to the fundamentals of doing social science research in LIS. Students will learn how to frame a research problem, choose an appropriate research method, apply it, and write up the research for presentation and publication. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Illinois Informatics Institute or Information Sciences department.
